{{Quote|Recently disclosed documents and testimony from a captured Thalassian slaver on Gyndine have implicated four Outer Rim Senators as profiting from slaving ventures in their sectors. Senator Tikkes (Mon Calamari), Senator Bufus Ritsomas (Till Chorios), Senator Danry Ledwellow (Er'kit) ''[sic]'' and Senator Wuja Wojaine (Pydyr) were all implicated.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report|<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}}</ref>}}
'''Er'Kit''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]]. Remaining a part of the Republic during the subsequent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Er'Kit also was a member of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with the future [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Treuten]] and [[Kosh Teradoc]] hailing from the planet. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Er'Kit was a member of various Imperial splinter factions, including the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Description==
Er'Kit was a terrestrial<ref name="Warlords" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Er'Kit system/Legends|Er'Kit system]], a part of the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urban world]]<ref name="AotCIllustratedCompanion" /> situated on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Borgo Prime system|Borgo Prime]] and [[Storinal system/Legends|Storinal systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route also linked it to the [[Hewett system/Legends|Hewett system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Er'Kit appeared [[Color/Legends|brown]], tan, and gray.<ref name="FF1">{{FactFile|1|[[:File:Galaxymap3.jpg|Galaxy Map Poster]]}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:OdyMandrell-TPM-TheExpandedVisualDictionary.png|thumb|left|220px|Er'Kit was the homeworld of the species of the same name.]]
The area of space including Er'Kit was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the final phase of the [[New Sith Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]], the planet was a part of the territories unaligned with or contested by the two factions.<ref name="TEA" /> At least [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|one]] member of<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|odymandrell|Mandrell, Ody}}</ref> Er'Kit's native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|same name]]<ref name="CSWE" /> resided offworld<ref name="DB" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="32BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which include the appearance of [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> By the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:4]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]] represented Er'Kit in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. Ledwellow was implicated in participating in an Outer Rim [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] ring that saw the senator profit from the activities of [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian enslavers]] in the Noonian [[Sector/Legends|sector]], a fact that was noted by an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN50" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Er'Kit was situated within Republic-controlled space,<ref name="TEA" /> and the Republic's [[Ninth Army|Ninth Sector Army]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the planet's vicinity during the first campaigns of that conflict in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], however, the planet remained undecided on its affiliation to either the Republic or the Confederacy.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref> Er'Kit fell within the borders of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and at some point by the time of the Empire's [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], the brothers and future [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Treuten]] and [[Kosh Teradoc]] were born a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] apart into a hardscrabble family on the planet.<ref name="Warlords" />

[[File:Treuten_Teradoc.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Treuten Teradoc (pictured) and his brother Kosh were born on Er'Kit.]]
Er'Kit lay within the territory of the Empire's [[Oversector Outer]] in the immediate aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], but advances by the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] against Imperial splinter factions in the wake of that engagement resulted in the [[Oversector/Legends|oversector's]] boundaries having receded from the planet [[6 ABY/Legends|two years]] later. Er'Kit was nevertheless situated within [[Imperial Space]] between [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and, by [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], was specifically located within the borders of the Imperial-controlled territory consolidated during Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic in the [[9 ABY/Legends|preceding year]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet fell within the borders of the [[Imperial Reunification|reorganized]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], but, once again, an [[Imperial Skirmishes|offensive]] by the New Republic left it outside the boundaries of the former government by [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Er'Kit system|conquered]] the Er'Kit system between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the system remained under the invaders' control by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Er'Kit was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="DB" /> Er'Kit species.<ref name="CSWE" /> By the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire, the planet was also home to a family that included<ref name="Warlords" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Humans" /> brothers Treuten and Kosh Teradoc.<ref name="Warlords" /> The population of the Er'Kit [[Star system/Legends|system]] around 25 ABY numbered between one and ten million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Er'Kit was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> The first visual depiction of the planet was on a [[2001]] map of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' galaxy designed by [[James King]] and [[Laurence Butler]] and included with the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 1|first issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine.<ref name="FF1">{{FactFile|1|[[:File:Galaxymap3.jpg|Galaxy Map Poster]]}}</ref>

[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #50]]<ref name="HNN50" /> and [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #51]], two issues of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|representation]] of the [[in-universe]] HoloNet News<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}}</ref> that were written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and respectively published by [[April 4]]<ref name="HNN50 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6308795|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mavrick889|date=2002-04-04|time=3:16 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072747/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-8}}</ref> and [[April 11]] of [[2002]],<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=MattPeriolat|date=2002-04-11|time=6:19 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072817/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-10}}</ref> both capitalized the planet's name as "Er'kit."<ref name="HNN50" /><ref name="HNN51" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Er'Kit system, and therefore Er'Kit itself, in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" />
